description: Hand-written: the build.* rows’ own contract (PL.native-headless-build, U106(1), U107; core’s headless build contract, P10.core) — each row’s answer shape over core’s functions, the details core’s corpus does not pin (refusal, note and issue sentences, which the rows answer whole), the plan’s refusals sent back as a refused result’s, the line, size, credential-scan, fold, containment, order, platform and primary-artefact rows no corpus case calls directly (including keys that lower-case through a non-ASCII letter, which core’s corpus does not state), and the rows’ own refusals as errors coded [invalid-input]. Every expectation here was computed by core’s own functions at the pin, not by these rows. Core’s own corpus (conformance/build/headless.json, 233 cases) is driven whole through these rows by the build_corpus ctest (tests/build_corpus.cpp), not transcribed here.
